'''Amadaine 7 (June 14)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>

*{{ne|998}} - [[Ingtar Shinowa|Ingtar's]] party continue to follow the [[Trolloc]]s.
*{{ne|998}} - [[Moiraine]] and [[Lan]] leave the [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin's]] party, followed by [[Liandrin]]. [[Verin]] leaves shortly afterwards, without her [[Warder]], [[Tomas]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Perrin]] meets Lord [[Slayer#Luc Mantear|Luc]] and convinces the outlying farmers to take refuge in [[Emond's Field]]. That night, he leads the rescue of the captives from the [[Whitecloaks]].
*{{ne|999}} - In [[Rhuidean]], [[Rand]] emerges from the [[glass columns]]. He finds [[Mat]] hanging from ''[[Avendesora]]'' and revives him. On the way out of the city, a [[bubble of evil]] strikes.
